shellCommands.command:
PORT=3001 NODE_ENV=test node server.js & 
sleep 1
echo "--- GET / ---"
curl -s http://localhost:3001/ | head -n 80
echo "--- POST /books ---"
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3001/books -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" -d "title=Test+Book&author=Test+Author&notes=My+notes" -c /tmp/cookies -L | grep -o "Test Book" | head
echo "--- Check JSON ---"
cat data/books.json
echo "--- GET /api/books ---"
curl -s http://localhost:3001/api/books | head -c 500
echo ""
BOOK_ID=$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('data/books.json','utf8'))[0].id)")
echo "BOOK_ID=$BOOK_ID"
echo "--- GET /books/:id ---"
curl -s http://localhost:3001/books/$BOOK_ID | grep -E "Test Book|Test Author|My notes|Shareable" | head
echo "--- POST finish ---"
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3001/books/$BOOK_ID/finish -H "Accept: application/json" | head -c 500
echo ""
echo "--- Verify dashboard sections ---"
curl -s http://localhost:3001/ | grep -E "Currently Reading|Finished" | head
echo "--- Kill server ---"
pkill -f "node server.js" ; sleep 1; cat data/books.json

PORT=3001 node server.js &
sleep 1
curl -s http://localhost:3001/ | head -n 50
ps aux | grep server
cat /tmp/*.log 2>&1 | head

curl -s -i -X POST http://localhost:3001/books -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" -d "title=Test+Book&author=Test+Author&notes=My+notes"
echo "---"
cat data/books.json
BOOK_ID=$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('data/books.json','utf8'))[0].id)")
echo "BOOK_ID=$BOOK_ID"
curl -s http://localhost:3001/books/$BOOK_ID | grep -i "Test"
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3001/books/$BOOK_ID/finish | head
curl -s http://localhost:3001/ | grep -A2 -E "Currently Reading|Finished"
cat data/books.json
kill %1; sleep 1
cat data/books.json
pkill -f "node server.js"; sleep 1; echo killed; cat data/books.json
ps aux | grep node; cat data/books.json; rm data/books.json; echo "[]" > data/books.json; cat data/books.json; ls -l
